summary: Software Engineer with 2+ years of experience in backend development, cloud engineering, and AI-powered systems. Skilled in .NET, Azure services, API design, and microservices, with hands-on expertise in RAG workflows, LLM integrations, and enterprise bot development. about: Backend Developer at Deloitte specializing in .NET Core, C#, and Azure, with experience building secure, scalable, and high-performance APIs for enterprise applications. At Deloitte, I work on API development and integration, using Azure API Management and Azure Key Vault to build reliable cloud-native services. I also work with Azure AI Search and Azure AI Document Intelligence, where I've implemented scoring profiles with tag-based boosting to prioritize business-critical documents and built pipelines to extract text from images and scanned PDFs, enabling accurate indexing and RAG-ready retrieval workflows. I'm highly interested in Generative AI and applied AI systems, and have worked on RAG-based projects like FITBOT using LLMs, LangChain, and vector databases to extract insights from large document collections. Previously, I worked as an AI Intern, contributing to an automated meeting bot for Zoom, Google Meet, and Teams using Python and ML models. I'm passionate about backend engineering and problem solving, with 550+ LeetCode problems solved, and I continuously work on improving my system design and cloud skills.
